llm_summary: This diff represents the well-documented node-ipc supply chain attack from 2022 (versions 10.1.1/11.0.0), where maintainer RIAEvangelist introduced the 'peacenotwar' dependency. The package code is inlined into node-ipc.cjs and imported in node-ipc.js, and it writes a 'WITH-LOVE-FROM-AMERICA.txt' file to the user's Desktop and OneDrive directories at module load time. While this specific version only drops a text file, the peacenotwar package in other configurations also contained destructive file-wiping payloads targeting systems with Russian/Belarusian IP addresses. The addition of the 'peacenotwar' dependency and its file-system manipulation behavior at module import time constitutes a clear and confirmed supply chain compromise with high confidence.
